title: Approved M8 project package removal tools

x-alcomd-tools.name: alcomd_list_projects
x-alcomd-tools.title: List authorized projects
x-alcomd-tools.description: Read registered project summaries. This list is filtered by current Core authorization.

x-alcomd-tools.name: alcomd_get_project
x-alcomd-tools.title: Read a project package snapshot
x-alcomd-tools.description: Read the registered project and package snapshot. A removal plan rechecks the current project files.

x-alcomd-tools.name: alcomd_plan_package_uninstall
x-alcomd-tools.title: Review a package removal
x-alcomd-tools.description: Create a real immutable removal plan. Show every change and dependency risk before requesting confirmation. This does not write project files.

x-alcomd-tools.name: alcomd_apply_package_changes
x-alcomd-tools.title: Apply a reviewed removal plan
x-alcomd-tools.description: Only call after the operator has reviewed the complete plan and confirmed its risks. Applies that original removal plan; never replans. An accepted operation is not completed work.

x-alcomd-tools.name: alcomd_get_operation
x-alcomd-tools.title: Read a package operation
x-alcomd-tools.description: Read the authoritative package apply status and result. A failed task remains failed even when this read succeeds.

x-alcomd-tools.name: alcomd_cancel_operation
x-alcomd-tools.title: Request package operation cancellation
x-alcomd-tools.description: Request cooperative cancellation. Cancelling is not cancelled; some phases cannot be cancelled and the operation may complete successfully.

zip_sha256.description: Optional publisher digest. Exactly 64 hexadecimal characters, in either case, are verified against the archive. Other values are treated as absent.
